title: Prelaunch Signal Collector and SLO Matrix
description: Working sheet to collect prelaunch signals, map SLAs/SLOs to gates, and provide a short contingency playbook. Designed for cross-functional launch checkpoints and daily cadence during the final 4 weeks.
body:
Purpose:
- Single-pane checklist + KPI table for prelaunch 28->0 day runway. Capture signal owners, collection frequency, gating thresholds, and quick mitigation steps.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted API feature rollout (new streaming chat endpoint + optional function-calling). Includes metric, infra, security, docs readiness. Excludes billing contract negotiations (handled by GTM).

Summary / quick status (as of last_modified):
- Overall go-criteria: 12/15 hard metrics within green, 3 mitigations identified (2 scheduled, 1 ok to ship with monitoring).
- Primary risk: prefix-cache warmup causing tail latency spike under burst traffic.

KPI / Signal Table (collected -> polling cadence -> owner -> green/yellow/red thresholds -> quick mitigation):
- requests_per_minute_over_1m | 1m | Diego Alvarez | G:<10k Y:10k-30k R:>30k | Mitigate: auto-burst to reserved, enable throttling route fallback
- p50_latency_stream_ms | 1m | Priya Sharma | G:<80 Y:80-200 R:>200 | Mitigate: reduce batch window for 3 minutes, route to faster model variant
- p95_latency_stream_ms | 1m | Priya Sharma | G:<150 Y:150-600 R:>600 | Mitigate: incremental rollout pause + cache pre-warm script
- error_rate_5m (%) | 5m | Maya Chen | G:<0.2% Y:0.2-1% R:>1% | Mitigate: circuit-breaker to fallback model, rollback client-side consumer changes
- generation_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd | daily | Product Ops | G:<$0.80 Y:$0.80-1.50 R:>$1.50 | Mitigate: switch to quantized variant for non-critical routes, enable token cap
- function_call_misfires_per_1000_calls | 15m | Eng-Solutions | G:<1 Y:1-5 R:>5 | Mitigate: disable function-calling in canary, revert parser changes
- prefix_cache_hit_ratio | 5m | Serving Runtime | G:>70% Y:40-70% R:<40% | Mitigate: force cache populate, decrease eviction aggressiveness
- infra_gpu_utilization (%) | 5m | Infra | G:30-70 Y:70-90 R:>90 | Mitigate: spin up burst pool, reduce max batch size temporarily

SLO / Gate mapping (hard vs advisory):
- Hard gates (require green or approved mitigation): p95_latency_stream_ms, error_rate_5m, infra_gpu_utilization.
- Advisory gates (monitor, can ship with monitoring+mitigation): cost per token, prefix_cache_hit_ratio, request rate growth shape.

Readiness checklist (quick bullets, mark owner & due date):
- Observability: dashboards wired for all KPI rows + alerting thresholds (owner: Priya, due: 2024-12-01)
- Docs: quickstart + streaming examples, function-calls examples updated (owner: Maya, due: 2024-12-05)
- Rollout plan: 0->1%->10%->50%->100% with 24h soak and success criteria at each stage (owner: Jordan, due: 2024-12-03)
- Canary automation: automated rollback if p95 > threshold for 10m (owner: Release Eng, due: 2024-12-02)
- Security review: token scope check & KMS policy verification (owner: Security, due: 2024-11-20)
- E2E tests: include payloads that exercise long contexts and function calling (owner: Eng QA, due: 2024-11-28)

Risk matrix (short):
- Tail latency spike (likelihood: medium) -> impact: high -> mitigations: pre-warm caches, temporary throttling, model fallback.
- Regressed generation quality with quantized model (likelihood: low) -> impact: high -> mitigations: A/B compare against control prompt set, allow rollback.
- Billing surge from loops in client (likelihood: low) -> impact: medium -> mitigations: hard token caps, request rate limits at ingress.

Contingency playbook (one-paragraph runbook for a p95 > 600ms spike):
- Immediate: pause rollout, flip traffic to previous model variant with fast path, notify SRE & product ops.
- Short-term: enable smaller batch window, trigger cache pre-populate job, increase autoscale target for reserved pool.
- Post-incident: capture trace & KV cache metrics, root-cause session, commit remediation PR and add to postmortem with action owners and deadlines.

Operational cadence and meeting hooks (final 28 days):
- Daily (09:30 PT): 15-minute ops standup for signal review (owners only).
- T-7 days: full cross-functional go/no-go review.
- T-1 day: freeze non-critical PRs, final smoke test run.

Notes to self (workshop fragments):
- Consider adding a simple derived metric: "time_to_first_token_ms" for UX regressions.
- Test cold-start behavior by orchestrating synthetic jobs that simulate thousands of small bursts.
- Add trace sampling on error rate spikes to 100% for 10 minutes to get richer context.

Next actions (who/what/when):
- Priya: finish dashboard panels + alert runbook (due 2024-11-15).
- Diego: load-test prefix-cache warmup with 2x expected burst (due 2024-11-12).
- Jordan: finalize rollout percentages and schedule canary windows (due 2024-11-10).

Linked tickets / references:
- JIRA-ENG-3421 (canary automation), CONFLUENCE-PLAT-98 (architecture notes), github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/278 (rollout orchestration PR).

Freeform / half-baked ideas:
- Could use an "adaptive gate" that pauses rollout only when both latency + cache ratio are bad (reduces noise from single flakey signal).
- Experiment: run a 2-hour pre-roll warmup at 5% traffic to populate common prefixes.

End of sheet.
